integrity.claim: Exact formula and weak/strong tension boundary laws proved analytically; numerical checks are finite consistency tests only.
integrity.prior_coverage: Classical mesh-independent and filter representations are attributed; possible equivalent historical special cases not ruled out.

limitations: Whole-line cardinal uniform-knot model only; no finite-interval boundary conditions or arbitrary-mesh sharp formula.
The existence, not the uniqueness or value, of an interior maximizing tension is established.
The accessible 2004/2005 primary material is incomplete; historical equivalent coverage remains possible.
title: Exact endpoint norms for cardinal exponential-spline orthoprojectors
